svg.title: Azure OpenAI Capacity Decision Framework
svg.desc: Start from the traffic estimate in tokens per minute and ask whether the peak is sustained. If yes, above 100K tokens per minute, use PTU: reserved capacity with predictable latency. If traffic is spiky or variable, use pay-as-you-go: the S0 tier with shared capacity. If both, use a PTU baseline with pay-as-you-go overflow.
svg.text: Size capacity from the traffic estimate: is the peak sustained?
